description: SMB DTC brands sourcing custom packaging (mailers, boxes, inserts) from suppliers. Included as the THIRD vertical to prove the system is config, not code — no agent changes vs. wedding-dress.json / moving.json. Mirrors the b2b_packaging_smb vertical in negotiator/market_benchmarks.py.

specFields.prompt: What packaging material and print spec do you need (e.g. corrugated mailer box, kraft mailer, custom 4-color print, matte vs gloss finish)?
What order quantity are you planning — a one-time run, or an ongoing minimum order quantity?
What are the box or mailer dimensions?
What lead time do you need, and how much flexibility do you have on the ship date?
Do you need freight/delivery included, or will you arrange your own logistics?
What payment terms are you looking for (e.g. NET-30, NET-15, deposit + balance)?
Is this a one-time order or would you consider an annual volume commitment for a better rate?

priceBenchmark.source: Personalized packaging market 2024 · SMB e-com aggregate (see negotiator/market_benchmarks.py: b2b_packaging_smb/annual_contract)
priceBenchmark.note: Annual packaging spend for a growing DTC SMB. Ground truth for red-flag detection. Replace with a live benchmark feed for production.

redFlags.message: B2B reps have tiered discount authority (L1 5-10%, L2 10-20%, Manager 20-40%). An offer stuck ~10% above target usually means the rep is at their authority ceiling — ask to escalate to a manager.
Market Development Funds / co-op program discounts are often unclaimed by SMB buyers who don't know to ask. Always ask directly regardless of the quoted price.
Plate/setup fees, rush charges, and freight commonly stack to 30%+ above the base per-unit quote — ask for a fully itemized quote before comparing.

callListSource.query: custom packaging supplier OR corrugated packaging manufacturer
callListSource.note: Also supports direct sourcing platforms (Alibaba, ThomasNet) for suppliers without a local listing.

counterpartyStyles.description: Holds firm at list price, wants a signed annual commitment before discounting.
'We need to route this through sales engineering for a formal quote' — must extract a per-unit ballpark and MOQ before hanging up.
Bundles plate/setup fees, rush production, and premium finishes into the total. Agent must itemize and challenge each line.

disclosure: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a company evaluating packaging suppliers for a new sourcing round. I want to be upfront that I'm an AI — I'm gathering pricing, MOQ, and terms information. Do you have a few minutes for some quick questions?
